page.layout: Running head centred at top, page number top right. Continuation of a letter from the previous page: one paragraph. Below it, the closing block of the letter (place and date at left, complimentary close at right, signature at right below). Then the heading "EPIST. LI.", a title line in two-line italic and roman form, the greeting, and the body in one column of text. Catchword at lower right, gathering signature at lower left.

main_text.l: faites estat de moy en revanche com-me.
A Aix ce 2 Juin 1637. Vostre tres-humble
J. Morinus Petro à Valle. De Codici-
Perillustri D. D. Petro à Valle Joannes Morinus S.P.D.
Suspicari non abs re potuisti, perill-
ustris Domine, me tui beneficii, quod
à te accepi, immemorem esse, cùm jam
annus alter effluxerit, aut etiam amplius,
ex quo de me deque tuo Manuscripto Sa-
maritano nihil prorsus acceperis, aut e-
tres menses R. Patri Goezaldo, ut te meo

page.notes: The initial S of "Suspicari" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to the word. The page number and the gathering signature are faint and uncertain. "Rescripsera" and "Goezaldo" are read from the scan and may be misprinted or misread; the signature "S 5" is uncertain. No marginal notes are printed on this page. The digitiser's watermark at lower right is excluded.
